card.name: Stock phrases in injection label warnings
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a small word right before the end of a familiar label phrase, such as the comma after "adequate precautions" in local anesthetic warnings. Also "required" after "minimum" and "container" in "solution and container permit".

modes.label: Anesthetic safety sentence
modes.description: The comma or "and" inside "proper dosage, correct technique, adequate precautions, and readiness for emergencies".
modes.example: The safety and effectiveness of lidocaine hydrochloride depend on proper dosage, correct technique, adequate precautions<<,>> and readiness for emergencies.

modes.label: Other set label phrases
modes.description: A word just before a predictable ending in fixed label wording, such as "minimum required" or "solution and container permit".
modes.example: Limit dosages and durations to the minimum<< required>>. Inform patients and caregivers of this potential
